svg.title: Syed Muqeet Ahmed: hismuq identity runtime
svg.desc: A terminal-style window titled hismuq.system --live. On the left, an abstract particle mark of the hismuq wordmark initial, crossed by a heartbeat signal and wired with agent nodes, is scanned, analysed, deconstructs into a particle field and reconstructs. On the right: Syed Muqeet Ahmed, AI engineer and systems builder, working across AI, healthcare and software. Core: agents, RAG, ML and EHR. Building healthcare software and intelligent systems. Research: reliable AI and ML systems. Education: AI and ML at Osmania University. Based in Hyderabad, India. Identity: Hismuq. A live indicator cycles through listening, analyzing, retrieving, building and answering. The animation is optional.
